messages:
kai: hi all, first day! unboxed my MBP M3 and went through setup. i signed in with SSO during setup and later ran the Company Portal to enroll. Enrollment says 'MDM enrolled' but System Settings shows 'This Mac is not supervised'. do i need to wipe to get supervised mode?

it-bot: Device check: kai-device-1775601111. MDM status: enrolled (user-approved). Supervision: false. FileVault: enabled.

itops: hey kai, welcome :wave: thanks for the logs. correct — signing into SSO during Setup Assistant can trigger a user-approved enrollment (UAMDM) when the device wasn't assigned in ABM/DEP at OOBE. Supervision (DEP/ABM enrollment) requires automated enrollment at first boot.

kai: ah ok. is there a way to convert without erasing? i have a few local files i want to keep.

brooke: short answer: no, supervision requires a factory reset and ABM-provisioned OOBE flow. long answer: you can back up user data (Time Machine to external drive or iCloud), erase, and re-enroll to get supervised state. we can also assist with a one-time user data snapshot if you prefer.

paul: if you prefer not to wipe today, note that many policies requiring supervision (e.g., kernel extension consent, some kernel-managed VPN profiles, and automated recovery key escrow settings) won't apply. FileVault will still be enabled but the recovery key won't be stored as a supervised escrow; instead our MDM will only have limited recovery options.

kai: ok makes sense. timeline question: how long does a remote erase + reprovision take?

itops: typically 5-10 minutes for the remote erase to kick and then 5-15 minutes to complete OOBE and automated enrollment, assuming good network. total ~15-30m depending on how fast you do the setup steps. we'll reassign serial in ABM first so OOBE shows "Managed by Redwood Inference".

kai: here's my serial from About -> Serial: C02M3KAI1234.

it-bot: ABM lookup: serial C02M3KAI1234 currently unassigned.

brooke: reassigning now and sending remote erase. i'll DM the exact steps for backing up your ~/ and plist files if you want.

paul: backup note: easiest is plugged-in external drive + `tmutil startbackup --destination /Volumes/EXT` or use Migration Assistant later. if you need guidance on excluding large caches, let us know.

kai: doing a quick Time Machine backup to an external SSD now. will reply when it's done. thanks for the help.

it-bot: ABM update: serial C02M3KAI1234 assigned to "Redwood Automated Enroll". Remote erase command issued.

kai: backup finished. ready for remote erase.

brooke: kicked the erase. watch for the erase notification. after wipe, choose Redwood-Secure during setup and do not sign into personal Apple ID. open Safari at the network step and the device will auto-enroll.

kai: got the erase notice and it's rebooting. on first boot i see "This Mac is managed by Redwood Inference" 389. enrollment completed and Settings shows Supervision: supervised. nice.

it-bot: Enrollment succeeded for device-1775601111. Profile: Redwood MDM (supervised). FileVault: enabled and recovery key escrowed.

paul: i've pushed the additional certs and VPN profile now that the device is supervised. verify VPN can connect and check `sudo fdesetup status` to confirm recovery key escrow.

kai: `sudo fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On." I also checked Intune/MDM portal and the recovery key is present. VPN connects fine. thanks!

brooke: final note on admin rights: we grant temporary admin for 7 days for supervised devices. i've added you to dev-install group. we'll revoke after the window. reach out if you need an extension.

kai: confirmed i can `brew install` and Docker runs. extremely smooth after the supervised flow. thanks y'all :heart:
